# Banned-term guard for generated profile files.
# Each line: sha256 of a banned term (lowercase, letters and digits only), then its length.
# Terms are stored hashed so this repo never contains them in any form.
# build.py lowercases each generated file, drops everything but [a-z0-9], and hashes every window of each length.
